knock.definitionEn: To strike something, especially a door, with a firm, sharp sound, or to make such a sound.
knock.definitionCn: v. 敲；击；碰撞；发出敲击声；n. 敲；敲击声；（尤指汽车引擎的）爆震声；（用于表示）批评，非议

shake.definitionEn: To move something quickly back and forth or up and down; or to tremble involuntarily.
shake.definitionCn: v. 摇动；颤抖；握手；动摇；n. 摇动；震动；奶昔；（戏剧）谢幕时的欢呼

click.definitionEn: A short, sharp sound, or the action of making such a sound, often associated with pressing a button or a mouse.
click.definitionCn: n. 咔哒声；按键声；v. 发出咔哒声；点击

pour.definitionEn: To cause a liquid to flow in a stream from a container.
pour.definitionCn: v. 倒；倾泻；（雨等）倾盆而下；（目光、话语等）倾注；（人群）涌来

pack.definitionEn: A group of animals, especially wolves, that hunt together; or to put things into a container to be carried or stored.
pack.definitionCn: n. （尤指狼的）一群；背包；包装；v. 包装；打包；塞满；（军队）驻扎

slice.definitionCn: n. 片；切片；一份；（计算机）切片；（高尔夫球）削球；（桥牌）切牌；（计算机）切片；v. 切成片；切下；切碎；（计算机）切片

bend.definitionEn: To curve or cause to curve; to turn or cause to turn.
bend.definitionCn: v. 弯曲；使弯曲；转弯；使转向；屈服；屈从； n. 弯曲；弯；转弯处；曲折

load.definitionEn: A large quantity of something that is carried or transported, or the act of putting a large quantity of something onto a vehicle or into a container.
load.definitionCn: n. 负荷；装载量；（计算机）加载；（枪）弹药；（诗）负担；（俚）毒品；v. 装载；使充满；使负担重；（计算机）加载；（枪）装填

grab.definitionEn: To take or seize something suddenly and roughly, or to take an opportunity.
grab.definitionCn: v. 抓住；夺取；急忙赶去；n. 抓；夺；（尤指）一次（抓住或夺取）
